name: Montecristo 80 Aniversario
description:
Buy Montecristo 80 Aniversario – Montecristo 80 Aniversario for sale online

Buy Montecristo 80 Aniversario Cabinet Box of 20 Cigars, 6 1/2″x 55 The Montecristo 80 Aniversario was revealed to cigar lovers at the Festival del Habanos in Havana in March 2015 This Legend Cigars also shares its size with the limited edition Montecristo 80 Aniversario, to commemorate the brand’s 80th anniversary. As for the Linea 1935 name, it comes from the first year in which Montecristo cigars were released. When the iconic brand turned 80 years old. The 6 1/2 inch by 55 ring cigar, and is adorned with a bold, golden Montecristo band. It is a unique vitola, Edición Especial Casa del Habano. You will love the Cabinet cedar box full of divine aromas and taste.

Montecristo 80 Aniversario Experience for sale 

The Montecristo 80 Aniversario delivers an experience, unlike any other Montecristo cigar before it. Boldly satisfying, delicious, and smooth, The Montecristo 80 Aniversario provides a rewarding Cuban cigar journey best enjoyed after a hearty meal with conversation and a sturdy beverage. With only 30,000 boxes allotted worldwide, the Montecristo 80 Aniversario won’t be around forever. So, don’t wait to treat yourself to the Montecristo for the ages. Complement your Cuban cigar collection with the exquisitely crafted Montecristo 80 Aniversario and be a part of 80 years and counting of the Montecristo legacy.
